notes.title: HellSlave II - The Road to Release 🔥
notes.notes:
Hell'o everyone,

We’ve just wrapped up a [b]major milestone[/b] in the development of [b]Hellslave II[/b]! 🎉

The core content is now almost complete, and we’re entering the next crucial phase: [b]polish and balancing[/b].

This means we’ll be focusing on refining the experience, smoothing out rough edges, and making sure every system feels tight and satisfying to play.

It’s an exciting step, as the game is now really taking shape into what we envisioned from the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40432619/6c7b18f349499b571f1b090f09c9db12df338d91.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to share more updates with you soon!

– [i]Ars Goetia Games[/i]
